semantics.files: no blanket authorization; UIDocumentPicker grants scoped access to the selected URL
semantics.photoPicker: PHPicker selection does not request general photo-library access

limits: The compile and contract prove the permission routing and scoped-file semantics; they do not display an operating-system permission prompt.
PHPicker and UIDocumentPicker continue to own their user-selection lifecycle and are not replaced by broad authorization requests.
